_about: Build-time enrichment for material filings in the demo snapshot. 'line' is FINN's one-line read of the filing PDF; 'people' are extracted from the filing (profileSource says where any career history beyond the filing came from). At runtime the same fields are produced by lib/llm.js (summariseFilings, extractPeople) when GEMINI_API_KEY is set.

Sanjay D'Souza — ~27 years at the bank and 'a key architect' of its SME franchise — retires as Group Head, Business Banking.

https://www.bseindia.com/stockinfo/AnnPd.line: Binding term sheet: Vishay to take 49% of Kaynes Semicon for an OSAT JV (assembly, test, packaging + a Vishay captive line in India). Raghu Panicker to run it.

people.name: Raghu Panicker
people.profileQuote: The Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of KSPL shall be Mr. Raghu Panicker, who shall be responsible for the day-to-day management and operation of the business.

https://www.bseindia.com/stockinfo/AnnPd.line: Board approves a JV with Toyokawa Techno to make thin-film (TFT) display modules in India, alongside Q2 results.
Board meeting outcome: Q2 results, the Toyokawa Techno display JV, and strike-off of a dormant subsidiary.
High Court stays the pollution board's closure order on the Waluj plant (~2.5% of revenue); next hearing 19 Nov.
Maharashtra Pollution Control Board orders closure of the Waluj (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) plant under the Water and Air Acts.
Possible data leak at a third-party SaaS platform used to onboard vehicle-loan customers (~28.5 lakh on it); forensic probe under way, core systems unaffected.

https://www.screener.in/company/id/12740.line: Exchanges ask AU Bank to clarify a media report on a potential data leak.

https://www.bseindia.com/stockinfo/AnnPd.line: GST department searched the registered office over 29–30 Oct; the company says it cooperated and operations were unaffected.
NCLAT allows Polycab's appeal and sets aside NCLT Ahmedabad's 7 Oct order in Asier Metals vs Polycab.
QIP done: 76.8 lakh shares at ₹5,550 (3.66% below floor) — ₹4,265 cr raised; followed by ₹7,000 cr of NCDs on 4 Nov.
New 15K MTPA R32 (HFC) capacity at Surat starts commercial operations — the ₹236.5 cr project approved in Oct 2025.
